{{Quote|You have a TIE shuttle.''"<br />"''Indeed.''"<br />"''I'm not sure I can recall ever seeing one in private hands.|Luke Skywalker and Snaplaunce|audio=VoteSnaplaunce.flac|<ref name="FOTJ:C" />}}
'''''Vote Snaplaunce''''' was a [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle|TIE/sh shuttle]] owned by [[Snaplaunce]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of [[Hweg Shul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was originally part of a collection of restored vehicles owned by a [[Unidentified Imperial mechanic|retired mechanic]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] who settled on Nam Chorios around [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], after which the shuttle was purchased by the Ithorian and renamed eponymously, a point expressed in [[Color/Legends|red]] lettering over a vivid yellow paint job. ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was modified while in possession of its namesake, during which [[Time/Legends|time]] it was converted from military to civilian use. Snaplaunce used the shuttle as a traveling [[Politics/Legends|campaign]] advertisement, and had a tendency to loan it to prominent visitors to his [[City/Legends|city]].

In [[44 ABY]], Snaplaunce loaned the shuttle to visiting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his traveling companions. Master Skywalker, his son [[Ben Skywalker]], and their erstwhile [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ally [[Vestara Khai]] had made their way to Nam Chorios in pursuit of a dangerous entity known as [[Abeloth]]. ''Vote Snaplaunce'' then fell victim to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]], unbeknownst to its owner, and the shuttle was soon afterward attacked by Abeloth's allies in pursuit of the Jedi. A series of calculated malfunctions combined with the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] disarmament for civilian usage resulted in its near destruction, and forced its occupants to reconstruct the crashed shuttle into a makeshift [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] to complete that leg of their quest, and then to abandon ''Vote Snaplaunce'' in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] outside Hweg Shul.

==Description==
[[File:TIEshuttle.jpg|thumb|left|A standard TIE shuttle]]
{{Quote|Best not to practice your astrobatics or to buzz Koval Station.|Snaplaunce|<ref name="FOTJ:C" />}}
''Vote Snaplaunce'' was originally a standard [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle|TIE/sh shuttle]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="FOTJ:C" /> A standard TIE shuttle had a 7.8 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long hull based on the twin-cylinder design of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]]. The starboard [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a TIE [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] held one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and the port compartment could accommodate two passengers, one seated in front of the other.<ref name="GG3" /> The front passenger seat had access to a secondary [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] board, and the rear seat had access to a secondary [[Comm unit/Legends|communications]] interface.<ref name="FOTJ:C" /> With its [[Twin ion engine/Legends|twin ion engines]], a standard TIE shuttle could reach 1,050 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="GG3" /> but had no [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="BTM" /> Though armed with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]],<ref name="GG3" /> the TIE shuttle lacked [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="BTM" /> Although the TIE shuttle was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-sized craft, it was less maneuverable than many other fighters, such as the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWTSBSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] it was acquired by [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Snaplaunce]] of [[Hweg Shul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], the shuttle had been disarmed,<ref name="FOTJ:C" /> making it suitable for civilian use without a special weapons permit from the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]],<ref name="SOTG">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> though the support systems for the cannon were not physically removed. When he purchased the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Snaplaunce proceeded to repaint it bright [[Color/Legends|yellow]],<ref name="FOTJ:C" /> as opposed to the standard off-white color of most TIE series vessels,<ref name="BTM" /> and emblazoned the ship with red lettering proclaiming an [[Politics/Legends|election]] motto, which was also registered as the shuttle's new name: "Vote Snaplaunce." The vessel was assigned a registration number of XV 119. An emergency kit was stowed aboard which contained repair tools such as an [[Arc welder/Legends|arc welder]], and [[food rations]] were carried that would sustain one average [[Human/Legends|Human]] for two days. By [[44 ABY]], ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was still operational, but the shuttle's port [[Engine/Legends|engine]] had ten percent greater thrust than the starboard.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

''Vote Snaplaunce'' suffered significant damage from both sabotage and a crash in 44 ABY during [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] pursuit of the entity known as [[Abeloth]]. Following the crash, the other members of Master Skywalker's party, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fugitive [[Vestara Khai]], rebuilt ''Vote Snaplaunce'' from a wrecked starship into a jury-rigged [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Ben Skywalker was largely responsible for the design, which made use of the remaining functional components of the craft in a new physical configuration. The [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] systems still functioned, and the wiring from the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] support systems was used to restore the port [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]], while the starboard engine remained inactive. The wing arrays were partially dismantled and rebuilt into a wind rudder system controlled by pulley cables that ran through holes cut in the passenger compartment with an arc welder. Lacking the help of the damaged onboard [[Computer/Legends|computers]], navigation was achieved with a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and overhead [[Star/Legends|star]] patterns. The shuttle's [[Intercom/Legends|intercom]] system was used to coordinate steering, and the shuttle-turned-landspeeder could achieve fifty kilometers per hour over flat ground. It was in that configuration that ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was abandoned by Skywalker's party and recovered by Hweg Shul authorities.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

==History==
===Acquisition===
[[File:Hweg_Shul.png|thumb|left|Hweg Shul, docking place of ''Vote Snaplaunce'']]
{{Quote|Seeing this one, how could I resist?''"<br />"''How, indeed?|Snaplaunce and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="FOTJ:C" />}}
Around [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], approximately fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before Luke Skywalker's second visit to the world, a [[Unidentified Imperial mechanic|mechanic]] who had left the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] settled on Nam Chorios. He proceeded to sell several vehicles he had carefully restored. Among them was a TIE shuttle which had been disarmed.<ref name="FOTJ:C" /> Though the class was not normally available for public sale,<ref name="GG3" /> an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] named Snaplaunce purchased the shuttle from the ex-Imperial, painted it bright yellow, and emblazoned it with a slogan for his campaign for mayor of the Chorian [[City/Legends|city]] of Hweg Shul, "Vote Snaplaunce." Identified by the registry number XV 119, ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was also registered as the vessel's official name.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

===Turbulence===
{{Quote|If Snaplaunce tried to kill us, we don't pay for his repairs.|Vestara Khai|<ref name="FOTJ:C" />}}
Luke Skywalker returned to Nam Chorios in 44 ABY, pursuing the being known as Abeloth. Now the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] in [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], he was accompanied by his son, Ben Skywalker, and Vestara Khai, a Sith of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] who had reluctantly accompanied the Skywalkers on their quest. In the course of their search for Abeloth, they were led to believe that the disappearance of a local researcher, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cagaran Wei]], could be related to Abeloth's presence. At Wei's residence, they met with Mayor Snaplaunce.<ref name="FOTJ:C" /> As a former member of the [[Hweg Shul municipal police]], Snaplaunce had met Master Skywalker on his prior visit to Nam Chorios,<ref name="POT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> and as mayor he now chose to be involved in investigating a possible crime against a prominent [[Newcomer]]&mdash;a non-native resident of the planet&mdash;and to meet with prominent visitors to his city.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

Investigation of Wei's residence and the logs of his landspeeder provided a lead on the doctor's whereabouts, indicating that he regularly traveled to a point four hundred eighty-three kilometers outside the city. Snaplaunce used the resources of his office to locate any points of interest at that distance, and Skywalker's team soon found themselves in need of transportation to an abandoned [[rock ivory]] [[Rock ivory processing plant|processing plant]] northwest of Hweg Shul. Time was an important factor to the investigation, and a landspeeder would take hours to make the journey. Returning to the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Koval Station]] to either retrieve their vessel, the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', or charter a shuttle from [[Koval Transport]], would also take time. Snaplaunce thus decided to provide ''Vote Snaplaunce'' as a faster alternative.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

When the group reached the location where ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was parked, Master Skywalker was stunned, both by the presence of a weapon of his former enemy and the incongruity of what he considered to be its cheerful paint scheme and its sinister origins. He suppressed his dismay and held back some sarcastic comments as Snaplaunce explained the ship's history, briefed the Jedi on its eccentricities, and explained the flight restrictions in effect over Nam Chorios. The elder Skywalker took the controls, though he did not don a [[TIE pilot]] uniform, the younger Skywalker and Khai boarded the passenger pod, and the team set out to find Dr. Wei. Despite aerobatics being prohibited by the weapons platforms in orbit and the shuttle's own limited handling characteristics, Master Skywalker enjoyed traveling at a fair velocity while operating starfighter-style controls again. His enjoyment did not last long, however, as trouble came from behind the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]].<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

As the flight continued, ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was chased down by [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] in the [[Force psychosis|service]] of Abeloth. Ship was faster and, unlike the shuttle, was heavily armed. Using its [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]], Ship attacked ''Vote Snaplaunce''. Though the [[Iron/Legends|ferrous]] projectiles Ship hurled at the shuttle were detectable in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] by the shuttle's sensor suite, in atmosphere the ship automatically reconfigured its detection to the smaller and lighter debris commonly found near the surface. Master Skywalker was therefore unable to detect the projectiles without a distracting amount of effort. He was further hindered by ''Vote Snaplaunce''{{'s}} inherently poor maneuverability, and the battle soon attracted the attention of Nam Chorios's orbital control.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

===Degradation===
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker, pilot of ''Vote Snaplaunce'' at the time of its crash and reconstruction]]
{{Quote|Fun flight, Dad.''"<br />"''Quiet, you.|Ben and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="FOTJ:C" />}}
Koval Station Control hailed ''Vote Snaplaunce'' to command the ship to cease deviating from its flight plan. The elder Skywalker's lack of a TIE pilot helmet and its voice-activated communications, combined with his lack of familiarity with the shuttle's control systems, delayed his response to Koval Station. As the younger Skywalker managed to initiate a reply, the shuttle's electronics began to fail, and Koval Station began raining [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire in the shuttle's direction while Ship continued its pursuit. As Master Skywalker attempted to maneuver in such a way that the orbiting station could hit Ship, one of Ship's shots grazed the starboard wing of ''Vote Snaplaunce''. The elder Skywalker struggled to retain control of the damaged craft, but he was suddenly [[Death convulsion|assaulted]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a sentient being. The [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] caused Master Skywalker to lose control of ''Vote Snaplaunce''.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

''Vote Snaplaunce'' plummeted and spun until Master Skywalker regained control and activated the shuttle's repulsorlift system. He dropped ''Vote Snaplaunce'' into a [[Sandstorm/Legends|dust storm]] and Koval Station lost its weapons lock. Ship was stunned by the same Force trauma that affected Skywalker's team and fled. Although he briefly hoped that Koval Station had destroyed Ship, Master Skywalker realized that the death agony came from the destruction of a [[Tsil]], the sentient [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] lifeforms that dotted the surface of Nam Chorios. Now that the team was relatively safe, the younger Skywalker plotted a course to their original destination. Although they had not been hit by weapons fire, the shuttle's engines continued to falter as they closed in on the rock ivory processing plant. Master Skywalker resolved to compensate Snaplaunce for the damage to his ship&mdash;unless, of course, Snaplaunce himself had arranged for Ship's ambush, or had [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the ship. Within three hundred meters, the engines failed entirely, and Master Skywalker was forced to land the shuttle to prevent being blown away from their destination by winds.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

At the plant, Skywalker's team located Dr. Wei's body, and the trio reasoned out the probable sequence of events leading to his death. They determined that Wei had been used as bait to draw them out to the site and set them up for an ambush, and that either Snaplaunce was a conspirator or the sabotage was performed by someone who knew Snaplaunce had a tendency to loan ''Vote Snaplaunce'' to important visitors. The team inventoried their resources and evaluated the feasibility of repairing ''Vote Snaplaunce'', which did not look promising. Ben Skywalker examined the shuttle and located the nature of the sabotage, a powerful capacitor set up to direct a surge into the ship's systems as soon as the ship received any lengthy signal from orbital control. Though it took only [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to install, the system-wide damage it caused could take [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] to repair, and the younger Skywalker could not help admiring the saboteur's efficiency. As Khai was contesting his opinion, she realized that while the laser cannon was removed, its support systems had only been detached from the internal circuits. That fact provided the key to restoring any functionality to ''Vote Snaplaunce''.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

===Rebirth===
[[File:BenSkywalker_Atlas.jpg|thumb|left|Ben Skywalker, the Jedi responsible for ''Vote Snaplaunce''{{'s}} redesign into a landspeeder]]
{{Quote|We built junk racers more sophisticated than this out of spare parts when I was ten.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="FOTJ:C" />}}
While Master Skywalker communed with the Tsils to continue the hunt for Abeloth, his son and Khai redesigned ''Vote Snaplaunce'' into a unique wind-steered landspeeder. Master Skywalker approved of his son's sketch but amended the repair plan to include moving the shuttle downhill from the rock ivory plant to avoid detection by Ship. They pushed it under a rocky overhang and covered it in sand, which successfully concealed it from an overflight by Ship. Skywalker's team could not affect repairs during the day due to the windstorms that regularly battered the wilderness on Nam Chorios during daylight, so they shared the old but still edible rations stored aboard ''Vote Snaplaunce'' and rested until dark. The Skywalkers shared the passenger pod, and Khai slept alone in the pilot pod&mdash;the Sith believed that Master Skywalker arranged this to protect Ben from succumbing to any impulsive acts that could further complicate their group dynamic.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

After dark, the trio resumed their repairs. Activating the repulsors, they removed the sand that they had used for camouflage by taking advantage of the repulsors' vibration combined with manual sweeping. They turned the remains of the shuttle's wing arrays into wind rudders controlled by a set of pulleys made from the shuttle's hatch-closing wheels and cables run through holes cut into the hull with an arc welder that was stored in the shuttle's emergency toolkit. The port ion engine was restored to life with the wiring salvaged from the decommissioned laser cannon. Ben Skywalker took a moment to take [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] shots of their creation with his datapad, then the team planned their next move. Through his communion with the Tsils, Master Skywalker learned that the native [[Theran Listener]]s had been subverted; thus, much of the planetary population may have been turned against his team. They plotted a course back to Hweg Shul that avoided Human contact and stuck to flatlands&mdash;''Vote Snaplaunce'' could not navigate hills or mountains in its new configuration.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

Though steering was difficult, the shuttle's new configuration could achieve a speed of nearly fifty kilometers per hour. Steering adjustments had to be coordinated by intercom to control the port and starboard rudder pulleys, with the Jedi shouting until they were both hoarse. Lacking the help of the shuttle's computer, Master Skywalker had to plot their course by celestial navigation, comparing the stars overhead with a map on his datapad. At the end of another night, ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was parked against a hilly ridge and the team rested through another day cycle. Though the group had not been able to restore the shuttle's communication systems, they were finally close enough to Hweg Shul for their personal [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] to pick up broadcasts. They learned that [[Force storm (weather)|Force storms]] were ravaging the city and Snaplaunce had been assaulted before the daily dust storms cut communications off again. The shuttle remained parked until nightfall. When darkness fell once more, they were able to drive ''Vote Snaplaunce'' the remaining distance to Hweg Shul.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

Just before dawn, Skywalker's team parked ''Vote Snaplaunce'' for the last time and powered it down just outside Hweg Shul. Completing their journey on [[Limb/Legends|foot]], the group learned from public broadcasts that they were suspected of attacking Snaplaunce to steal his shuttle. As their hunt for Abeloth progressed, the team found themselves in need of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] once more, but ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was left alone as they stole a modified [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]] parked outside a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]]. When Snaplaunce recovered from his injuries, he cleared the Skywalkers and Khai of suspicion for his attack. His own recollection of the incident corroborated official city telemetry of the shuttle flight, proving the group had been in the air by the time he was attacked on the ground.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

While Skywalker's team was continuing to track Abeloth, [[Holojournalist/Legends|holojournalist]] [[Kandra Nilitz]] arrived on Nam Chorios with the Jedi [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]], who were still under the influence of Abeloth and had been compelled to find and assist her. After being abandoned by the Horns, she tried to track Master Skywalker's movements on the world. The reporter noted that ''Vote Snaplaunce'' was recovered outside Hweg Shul shortly before the theft and destruction of a T-47 airspeeder. Nilitz located the wreckage of the T-47 and found Master Skywalker and his team nearby. In exchange for her cooperation in his quest, Master Skywalker offered to tell her about Abeloth and the Lost Tribe of the Sith, or a detailed story about how his party got ''Vote Snaplaunce'' running again. The reporter accepted Skywalker's first story offer and declined the second.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

==Commanders and crew==
[[File:VestaraHS-FB.jpg|thumb|right|Vestara Khai, crewmember on ''Vote Snaplaunce'' at the time of its crash]]
{{Quote|A mechanic, late of the Imperial fleet, settled here about fifteen years ago and sold off several of the vehicles he had lovingly restored over the years.|Snaplaunce to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="FOTJ:C" />}}
After being released from the Imperial [[Navy/Legends|Navy]], the TIE shuttle went through a short succession of [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. It was owned and operated by an ex-Imperial [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] for some time before it was sold by the mechanic to Snaplaunce, the Ithorian mayor of Hweg Shul on Nam Chorios. Snaplaunce had a tendency to offer the shuttle to distinguished guests, and used it as a traveling campaign advertisement, naming it ''Vote Snaplaunce''. Snaplaunce became familiar with the shuttle's various eccentricities, and briefed Luke Skywalker on them when he loaned the shuttle to the Jedi.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

Luke Skywalker, exiled Grand Master of the Jedi Order, borrowed the shuttle in 44 ABY during his hunt for the entity known as Abeloth. A distinguished starfighter pilot, Skywalker initially enjoyed his command of the shuttle, but a lack of extensive experience with the shuttle's particular control layout led to some difficulty in using its communication systems, though the issue was soon rendered moot by sabotage.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

During Master Skywalker's command of ''Vote Snaplaunce'', he was backed up in the passenger pod by the other members of his team on the hunt for Abeloth. Master Skywalker's son, Jedi Knight Ben Skywalker, accompanied his father on his search for Abeloth after the Master's exile from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|administration]]. Ben Skywalker attempted to assist the Jedi Master with the secondary systems aboard ''Vote Snaplaunce'' during the battle with Ship, and was largely responsible for the shuttle's redesign into a landspeeder after its forced landing due to battle damage and system failure.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

Also accompanying him was Vestara Khai, a Sith of the Lost Tribe from the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Khai joined the Skywalkers' party on the hunt for Abeloth, initially as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]],<ref name="FOTJ:B">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> then as a fugitive from her own people after she was forced to kill a [[Sarasu Taalon|superior]] when he began to transform into another being of Abeloth's like.<ref name="FOTJ:V">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> Khai won an argument with the younger Skywalker over control of the front seat in the passenger pod of ''Vote Snaplaunce'' and was therefore in charge of the secondary sensor board. She later assisted Ben Skywalker in the repair effort after the shuttle's landing, and took control of one of the wing pulleys as they flew back to Hweg Shul.<ref name="FOTJ:C" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Vote Snaplaunce'' appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'' by [[Aaron Allston]], the seventh book of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, published in [[2011]].<ref name="FOTJ:C" />
